title: RocketReach Review (2026)
intro: RocketReach is a B2B contact database for professional emails, phones, and light prospecting automation. This review scores it with CRM methodology criteria — where pipeline depth is intentionally low versus data/outreach strengths.
summary: RocketReach fits buyers who want transparent contact-data pricing and Pro-tier phones/CRM sync. It is not a deal-pipeline CRM. Scores reflect first-party catalogue research, not hands-on testing.
verdict: RocketReach is a strong contact-data buy with clear Essentials/Pro/Ultimate pricing, but a weak CRM pipeline substitute. This review uses first-party pricing catalogue evidence — not hands-on testing.

faq.question: How much does RocketReach cost?
faq.answer: Individual USD pricing from the official catalogue (Aug 2026): Essentials $34/mo billed annually ($69 monthly), Pro $75/$119, Ultimate $142/$209. Confirm on rocketreach.co/pricing.

faq.question: Does Essentials include phone numbers?
faq.answer: No. The catalogue marks Essentials as email-only; mobile and direct phones start on Pro.

faq.question: Is this a hands-on SoftwareGlimpse lab review?
faq.answer: No. Approved from first-party RocketReach pricing/product research without recorded hands-on testing.

sections.heading: What RocketReach is
sections.body: RocketReach is a B2B contact database for finding professional emails, phones, and related company insights, with light prospecting automation — not a CRM pipeline product.

sections.heading: Pricing and plans
sections.body: Published individual plans are Essentials, Pro, and Ultimate with steep savings on annual billing. Phones and major CRM integrations start at Pro. Team plans are a separate custom path.

sections.heading: Core capabilities
sections.body: Search/enrich contacts, export within caps, run sequences/Autopilot, and connect Pro+ tools like Salesforce and HubSpot. Intent/healthcare data and SSO appear on Ultimate.

sections.heading: Who it’s for
sections.body: Best for individuals and small teams that want transparent contact-data pricing. Weak as a CRM replacement.

productExperience.summary: Typical flow: search contacts, reveal email/phone (plan-dependent), export or sync to CRM/SEP, and optionally run sequences/Autopilot jobs.
